plugins.author: k29t59dh, mrplow
plugins.description: Normalizes audio in a single pass: skips streams already AAC mono/stereo (unless force re-encode is enabled), encodes non-AAC mono/stereo streams to AAC with loudnorm, and downmixes any stream with more than 2 channels to stereo AAC with loudnorm. Caps sample rate at 48kHz, leaves lower rates untouched. Optional force re-encode mode checks loudness on already-compliant streams and only re-encodes if off-target, permanently tagging normalized streams so they are never re-measured or re-encoded again, even if formula settings change later.
plugins.name: AAC Stereo Downmix Skip 2ch

plugins.author: mrplow
plugins.description: Captures the modified-date (mtime) of a file before it is processed, and re-applies that same mtime to the resulting output file(s) once processing is complete. Useful for keeping original file dates intact when transcoding/converting media, so tools that sort or track files by modified date aren't confused by the new file appearing 'freshly modified'.
plugins.name: Preserve Original Modified Date
